Before I can even guess whether that's real: does "stale" mean the old value still shows, or the edit's missing from results entirely? And is the search backed by the same DB the edit writes to, or does it read from a separate index/cache (Elasticsearch, read replica, something with a refresh/TTL)?

That last part actually matters a lot — if there's any async reindex or cache in between save and search, "stale after edit" isn't just plausible, it's the expected failure mode, and it'd probably resolve itself after some delay. If search reads straight from the same store as the write, then it's a different and weirder bug — more worth chasing.

Can you get anything more from the user on: how long after saving did they search, was it a fresh search or a cached page, and did it self-correct on a retry a minute later? Even one of those would tell us which bug we're looking for.
